title: Architecture first,
built for production
overview.lead: ARG is an architecture-first software engineering company for fintech, SaaS and high-growth technology teams. We solve complex technical problems and build production-ready systems designed to scale and remain maintainable.

values.title: Architecture first
values.description: Clear system boundaries and technical decisions designed for performance, reliability and scale.

values.title: Production discipline
values.description: Software engineered for testing, observability, deployment and real-world operation.

values.title: Senior ownership
values.description: The engineers shaping the architecture stay accountable through delivery and production.

details.heading: Dedicated Product Teams
details.content: Senior ARG engineers work as a focused product team with ownership across architecture, delivery and production. We build, ship and evolve software as a long-term engineering partner.

details.heading: Senior Team Extension
details.content: Embed experienced engineers in your existing team to add delivery capacity, close technical gaps and strengthen architecture without lowering the engineering bar.

details.heading: Technical Consulting
details.content: Architecture reviews, scalability planning, modernization and technical strategy for systems where the decisions carry long-term consequences.

details.heading: MVP + Product Delivery
details.content: Focused MVPs can be delivered in 8-14 weeks, balancing speed with engineering judgment. The result is a production-ready foundation designed to learn, adapt and scale beyond the first release.

details.heading: AI Integration
details.content: Practical AI integrations, intelligent product features and workflow automation designed as reliable parts of production software, not isolated experiments.

details.heading: Cloud + Platform Engineering
details.content: Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability and platform engineering designed for reliable deployments, resilient operation and real-world production workloads.

projects.title: Proof in production, not promises.
projects.intro: Selected systems and products engineered for real-world use. Some engagements remain private by design; these are the projects we can discuss.

testimonials.quote: It was a pleasure to work with! Good communication, solid work, and helped us deliver our new version of the product in a timely fashion.
testimonials.author: Marc-Andre Mignault, Project Manager at Skytracks

testimonials.quote: ARG Software were great to work with from the first day. We needed a MVP for our tourism management company and they provided all the technical solutions we required, optimizing and improving our day-to-day operations. I definitely recommend ARG Software's team for their effort and great work. Thank you so much!
testimonials.author: Andre Mendo, CEO at Hostelier

testimonials.quote: Jose and Rui delivered good work and I enjoyed working with them. They transformed a legacy API from PHP to TypeScript, where their architectural skills in building an object-oriented backend were really handy. They were quick in extending their knowledge and competence in TypeScript-based projects to successfully complete the project. It is likely that we will hire them in the future for projects.
testimonials.author: Hendrik, CTO at Dokutar

testimonials.quote: ARG did great! Was awesome to work with and always quick to respond. Great attitude despite project requirements changing. Also helped out in a few tight spots with last-minute requests - highly recommend working with ARG!
testimonials.author: Austin Klise, CEO at Klise Consulting

workStats.title: Senior Ownership
paragraphs: ARG works best when the problem is complex, the stakes are real, and the system has to last. We keep the team small, senior, and close to the work: understand the risk, design the path, ship the code, and stay accountable when it reaches production.
No vendor theatre, no endless status loops. You get direct technical conversations, clear trade-offs, fast answers, and the discipline to say no when a shortcut will cost you later.

team.intro: Small by design. Senior by default. ARG is led by engineers who stay close to the architecture, code and production reality. You work directly with the people responsible for the technical decisions.
